items.name: ArrayExpress
items.description: Functional Genomics Data from high-throughput functional genomics experiments.

items.name: BacDive
items.description: Bacterial Diversity - information on taxonomy, morphology, physiology, and ecology of bacterial strains with genome and other molecular data. BacDive is a bacterial metadatabase that provides strain-linked information about bacterial and archaeal biodiversity. .

items.name: Bgee
items.description: Bgee is a database for retrieval and comparison of gene expression patterns across multiple animal species. It provides an intuitive answer to the question “where is a gene expressed?” and supports research in cancer and agriculture, as well as evolutionary biology.

items.name: BioImage Archive
items.description: The BioImage Archive is a public repository for biological images, supporting the deposition and reuse of reference imaging data that underpin published research across the life sciences.

items.name: BioStudies
items.description: The BioStudies database holds descriptions of biological studies, links to data from these studies in other databases at EMBL-EBI or outside, as well as data that do not fit in the structured archives at EMBL-EBI. The database can accept a wide range of types of studies described via a simple format

items.name: BRENDA
items.description: Database of enzyme and enzyme-ligand information, across all taxonomic groups, manually extracted from primary literature and extended by text mining procedures, integration of external data and prediction algorithms.

items.name: CATH
items.description: A hierarchical domain classification of protein structures in the Protein Data Bank.

items.name: Cellosaurus
items.description: A knowledge resource on cell lines. It attempts to describe all cell lines used in biomedical research.

items.name: ChEBI
items.description: Dictionary of molecular entities focused on ‘small’ chemical compounds.

items.name: ChEMBL
items.description: Database of bioactive drug-like small molecules, it contains 2-D structures, calculated properties and abstracted bioactivities.

items.name: EGA
items.description: Personally identifiable genetic and phenotypic data resulting from biomedical research projects.

items.name: EMDB
items.description: The Electron Microscopy Data Bank (EMDB) is a public repository for electron cryo-microscopy maps and tomograms of macromolecular complexes and subcellular structures. It covers a variety of techniques, including single-particle analysis, electron tomography, sub-tomogram averaging, fibre diffractio

items.name: ENA
items.description: The European Nucleotide Archive (ENA) provides a comprehensive record of the world’s nucleotide sequencing information, covering raw sequencing data, sequence assembly information and functional annotation.

items.name: Ensembl
items.description: Genome browser for vertebrate genomes that supports research in comparative genomics, evolution, sequence variation and transcriptional regulation.

items.name: Ensembl Genomes
items.description: Comparative analysis, data mining and visualisation for the genomes of non-vertebrate species.

items.name: Europe PMC
items.description: Europe PMC is a repository, providing access to worldwide life sciences articles, books, patents and clinical guidelines.

items.name: GWAS Catalog
items.description: The NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog: a curated collection of all human genome-wide association studies, produced by a collaboration between EMBL-EBI and NHGRI.

items.name: HGNC
items.description: The HGNC (HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee) is a resource for approved human gene nomenclature containing ~42000 gene symbols and names and 1300+ gene families and sets.

items.name: Human Protein Atlas
items.description: The Human Protein Atlas (HPA) aims to map all the human proteins in cells, tissues and organs using integration of various omics technologies, including antibody-based imaging, mass spectrometry-based proteomics, transcriptomics and systems biology. This data allows exploration of the human proteome

items.name: The IMEx Consortium: represented by IntAct and MINT
items.description: IntAct provides a freely available, open source database system and analysis tools for molecular interaction data. MINT focuses on experimentally verified protein-protein interactions mined from the scientific literature by expert curators.

items.name: IMGT
items.description: A comprehensive information system for immunoglobulins or antibodies, T cell receptors, major histocompatibility complexes and related proteins. It provides expertly annotated data supporting immunogenetics, immunoinformatics, clinical and veterinary research and antibody engineering.

items.name: InterPro
items.description: Functional analysis of protein sequences by classifying them into families and predicting the presence of domains and important sites. Note: This is an umbrella resource to which many collaborating databases contribute. In naming InterPro as a Core Data Resource, the critical role of the constituent

items.name: JASPAR
items.description: JASPAR is the largest open-access database of curated and non-redundant transcription factor (TF) binding profiles from six different taxonomic groups.

items.name: MGnify
items.description: The MGnify platform facilitates the assembly, analysis and archiving of microbiome-derived nucleic acid sequences. The platform provides access to taxonomic assignments and functional annotations for nearly half a million analyses covering metabarcoding, metatranscriptomic, and metagenomic datasets,

items.name: LIPID MAPS®
items.description: LIPID MAPS is designed to be an open, systematic and standardised Lipidomics resource. Providing information on Lipids and their structures, properties and functions in biological processes.

items.name: LPSN
items.description: LPSN (List of Prokaryotic names with Standing in Nomenclature) provides authoritative information on the nomenclature of prokaryotes.

items.name: Orphadata Science
items.description: The Orphadata Science platform provides the scientific community with comprehensive, high-quality datasets related to rare diseases and orphan drugs, in a reusable and computable format.

items.name: OMA
items.description: OMA is a method and database for the inference of orthologs among complete genomes, supporting comparative genomics analyses.

items.name: OrthoDB
items.description: OrthoDB is a catalog of orthologous protein-coding genes across a wide range of species, supporting evolutionary and functional genomics studies.

items.name: PDBe
items.description: Biological macromolecular structures.

items.name: PomBase
items.description: PomBase is a comprehensive database for the fission yeast Schizosaccharomyces pombe, providing structural and functional annotation, literature curation and access to large-scale data sets.

items.name: PRIDE
items.description: Mass spectrometry-based proteomics data, including peptide and protein expression information (identifications and quantification values) and the supporting mass spectra evidence.

items.name: Reactome
items.description: REACTOME is an open-source, open access, manually curated and peer-reviewed pathway database.

items.name: Rhea
items.description: Rhea is an expert-curated knowledgebase of chemical and transport reactions of biological interest, and the standard for enzyme and transporter annotation in UniProtKB.

items.name: SILVA
items.description: SILVA provides comprehensive, quality checked and regularly updated datasets of aligned small (16S/18S, SSU) and large subunit (23S/28S, LSU) ribosomal RNA (rRNA) sequences for all three domains of life (Bacteria, Archaea and Eukarya).

items.name: STRING
items.description: Known and predicted protein-protein interactions.

items.name: SWISS-MODEL
items.description: SWISS-MODEL is a fully automated protein structure homology-modelling server, accessible via the Expasy web server, or from the program DeepView (Swiss Pdb-Viewer). The purpose of this server is to make protein modelling accessible to all life science researchers worldwide.

items.name: UniProt
items.description: Comprehensive resource for protein sequence and annotation data.

items.name: VEuPathDB
items.description: VEuPathDB provides access to diverse genomic and other large scale datasets related to eukaryotic pathogens and invertebrate vectors of disease. Organisms supported by this resource include (but are not limited to) the US-based NIAID list of emerging and re-emerging infectious diseases.

items.name: ArrayExpress
items.description: Functional genomics data. Stores data from high-throughput functional genomics experiments.

items.name: BioModels
items.description: Computational models of biological processes.

items.name: BioSamples
items.description: BioSamples stores and supplies descriptions and metadata about biological samples used in research and development by academia and industry.

items.name: BioStudies
items.description: Descriptions of biological studies, links to data from these studies in other databases, as well as data that do not fit in the structured archives.

items.name: BioImage Archive
items.description: Public repository for biological images supporting deposition and access to reference imaging data underpinning published research.

items.name: EGA
items.description: Personally identifiable genetic and phenotypic data resulting from biomedical research projects.

items.name: EMDB
items.description: The Electron Microscopy Data Bank is a public repository for electron microscopy density maps of macromolecular complexes and subcellular structures.

items.name: EMPIAR
items.description: EMPIAR, the Electron Microscopy Public Image Archive, is a public resource for raw images underpinning 3D cryo-EM maps and tomograms (themselves archived in EMDB). EMPIAR also accommodates 3D datasets obtained with volume EM techniques and soft and hard X-ray tomography.

items.name: ENA
items.description: The European Nucleotide Archive (ENA) provides a comprehensive record of the world’s nucleotide sequencing information, covering raw sequencing data, sequence assembly information and functional annotation.

items.name: EVA
items.description: The European Variation Archive covers genetic variation data from all species.

items.name: GWAS Catalog
items.description: The NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog is a curated collection of all human genome-wide association studies, produced by a collaboration between EMBL-EBI and NHGRI.

items.name: IntAct
items.description: IntAct provides a freely available, open source database system and analysis tools for molecular interaction data.

items.name: LIPID MAPS®
items.description: LIPID MAPS is designed to be an open, systematic and standardised lipidomics resource. Providing information on Lipids and their structures, properties and functions in biological processes.

items.name: DisProt
items.description: DisProt is a manually curated deposition database of intrinsically disordered proteins and protein regions, providing experimentally validated disorder annotations and associated functional information.

items.name: MetaboLights
items.description: Metabolite structures and their reference spectra as well as their biological roles, locations and concentrations, and experimental data from metabolic experiments.

items.name: ModelArchive
items.description: ModelArchive provides a unique stable accession code (DOI) for each deposited theoretical model of a macromolecular structure.

items.name: PDBe
items.description: Biological macromolecular structures.

items.name: PRIDE
items.description: Mass spectrometry-based proteomics data, including peptide and protein expression information (identifications and quantification values) and the supporting mass spectra evidence.

items.name: 3DBIONOTES API
items.description: A reusable platform-independent API call component for protein and gene metadata alignment, annotation, and integration across major bioinformatic data resources.

items.name: BioImage Informatics Index
items.description: A bioimaging resource (tool/workflow) finder based on biological questions, methods and tools with linked literature of the resource.

items.name: Bgee Knowledge Graph
items.description: The Bgee database through its SPARQL endpoint provides access to gene expression patterns in multiple animal species, which result from the integration and harmonisation of several data sources.

items.name: BridgeDb
items.description: A combination of a software framework and an API for mapping identifiers for related objects in life sciences.

items.name: Data Stewardship Wizard (DSW)
items.description: Data Stewardship Wizard (DSW) is a service for data management planning, i.e. preparing data management plans.

items.name: DisGeNET RDF API
items.description: An RDF SPARQL Endpoint for DisGeNET, a knowledge platform on human disease genes and variants.

items.name: European Galaxy Server
items.description: Galaxy is an interoperable open-source platform for scientific data analysis and sharing, covering diverse research fields such as *omics, machine learning, and climate science.

items.name: FAIR Cookbook
items.description: The FAIR Cookbook, a live, open, online, collaborative resource of hands-on recipes for “FAIR doers” in the Life Sciences.

items.name: FAIRsharing
items.description: A FAIR-supporting resource including a registry on data standards, repositories and policy, alongside informative and educational tools and services.

items.name: FAIRtracks
items.description: A set of JSON Schemas defining a draft minimal standard used to consolidate genomic track metadata from various sources, which can be queried by downstream clients through the TrackFind webtool/API.

items.name: g:Profiler
items.description: A gene-centric data integrator with web UI and API services.

items.name: Identifiers.org
items.description: Provider of persistent and compact identifiers for data objects in life sciences through a curated registry and associated resolver.

items.name: InterMine
items.description: Framework to integrate life sciences data based on an extensible data model, providing web interface and RESTful web services.

items.name: ISA Framework
items.description: The ISA (Investigation > Study > Assay) provides formats and tools to manage the experimental descriptions throughout the research life cycle, from collection, curation and deposition in public repositories, to analysis with existing tools and publication in data journals.

items.name: Jalview
items.description: Jalview is a Win/Mac/Linux/Web interactive graphical interface and command line tool for molecular sequence, alignment and 3D structure bioinformatics resource interoperability.

items.name: MOLGENIS
items.description: A flexible data integration platform to facilitate FAIR research data and accelerate scientific collaborations.

items.name: Omics Discovery Index (OmicsDI)
items.description: Provides a knowledge discovery framework across heterogeneous omics data (genomics, proteomics, transcriptomics and metabolomics).

items.name: Ontology Lookup Service
items.description: Repository for biomedical ontologies that aims to provide a single point of access to the latest ontology versions through web UI or RESTFUL API.

items.name: OpenEBench
items.description: OpenEBench is a platform to evaluate life sciences tools from two points of view: Scientific performance through community-based benchmarking and Quality through an Observatory of Software Quality.

items.name: PLAZA
items.description: Provides an integrative resource for functional, evolutionary, and comparative genomics in plants.

items.name: RDMkit
items.description: The RDMkit is an open-source, online toolkit for researchers and data stewards, providing Research Data Management (RDM) best practices in line with the FAIR principles.

items.name: BAR: Bio-Analytic Resource for Plant Biology
CIViC: Clinical Interpretation of Variants in Cancer
LPSN: List of Prokaryotic names with Standing in Nomenclature
items.host_countries: The List of Prokaryotic names with Standing in Nomenclature (LPSN) provides comprehensive information on the nomenclature of prokaryotes and related data.
